section.sectionSummaryBrief: The revelation of the inwardness of miracles clothed in nature will primarily be in the future, when the boundary will no longer conceal the unlimited light.
section.t: And behold, the revelation of the inwardness of the miracles that are clothed in nature
(the clothing being that through this the true essence of the unlimited light is revealed,
as above in section 9)
will be primarily in the future.
For now,
the boundary drawn from the name Sha-dai, from "I said to My world, 'Enough!'" and the unlimited light drawn from the name Havayah are two opposite matters.
Therefore there is room to say
that the existence of miracles clothed in nature is because in these miracles the boundary still remains
(drawn from "I said to My world, 'Enough!'")
that conceals the unlimited light of Havayah.
But in the future to come,
when the boundary will not conceal the unlimited light,
it will be felt in revelation that the clothing of miracles in nature is because through this the true essence of the unlimited light is revealed.
And this is "I did not make Myself known to them with My true attribute,"
that the revelation of the name Havayah now is a "true attribute,"
"attribute" meaning measurement and limitation,
that the unlimited light of Havayah is limited within the matter of the unlimited light,
and the revelation of Havayah that will be in the future will be above attribute
(as above in section 1),
for then,
even within the boundary there will be a revelation of the unlimited light51,
and as it is written52
"And the glory of Havayah shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see,"
that even physical flesh53
will see the revelation of the glory of Havayah,
with the coming of Mashiach our righteous one, speedily and truly.
